answer: The thread register is checked at draw time, delta lists the eligible set, and island seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 26 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 26 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 284 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
